title: {p} & {v} Tagine
steps: Brown the {p} in a heavy pot, then set aside on a clean plate.
Soften the {v} with the {spice}, then add the {sauce} and enough water or stock to half-cover.
Return the {p}, cover and simmer gently 30 to 40 minutes, until tender and any meat is at least 165°F / 74°C inside.
Serve over the {s}, with something fresh, like lemon or herbs.
tip: Beans can replace half the meat, and the veg and spices carry most of the flavor.
